evidence.why: Exact signature, field assignment, and ordered unconditional calls.
Stored player scale is propagated to instantiated fighter entities.
Effective model scale multiplies runtime factor by character attribute.
Applies scale vector to the root JObj, with an optional independent X override.
Common refresh consumes runtime scale in guarded associated-item updates.

reason: The setter, player caller, and resolved callees support the scale-factor type, slot-to-fighter propagation, immediate root-model update, and ordered common refresh. The common refresh conditionally forwards scale-derived values to associated items. The root model's X component can use an independent override; none of these retained values requires uniform scaling.
